title: H-HANDOFF-1 part A, the HOST'S CLOTHING STORE (Crown Clothing, self-service with baskets and a queue): both players inside with at least 3 live customers (the store never holds 6 - see preconditions); the host (owner, simulator) walks out and the client must CONTINUE the same customers (same ids, same done items) from the host's final snapshot; then the host walks back in and takes them back from the client's final snapshot. NO save. (Fold 3, 2026-09-26: the F1 hour-boundary leg moved to T-HANDOFF3 - it left no unbooked customers for leg 2.)
preconditions:
Reporter fixture session fx-hq1 (day 44, MERGED - vars.keepMerger true). Dev build with H-HANDOFF-1 (custstate / enterbuilding / exitbuilding / skipvote / skipstate / shopday / tilldupes / handoffbook, BAMP_DEV). The fixture loads at 17:38 with Client1 inside a building, so both step outside and take one consensus skip OUTDOORS to 10:45 the next morning (as T-SKIPHANDBACK does). The clothing store is the HOST's, so the host books it and simulates it whenever he is inside (2026-09-19 booking-player ruling).

PREMISE: at least 3 live customers with both players inside. The brief asked for 6; THE FIXTURE CANNOT GIVE 6 HERE: this store fills slowly (36-43 entries a day; 1-6 bodies seen at 10-12h in the batch-26 runs) and run T-HANDOFF1-20260926-202315 waited 180 s for 6 and saw 2-4. The >= 6 premise is carried by T-HANDOFF2 (the gym, 180-203 entries a day). The rig does not guess a sleep: `custstate arm 3` logs one line the moment the host's interior holds 3, and the step waits for that line (180 s).

LEG 1 (owner walks out): host exitbuilding -> the host's BuildingManager.ResetIndoors prefix sends the FINAL snapshot (reason exit, 'books here, N unfinished entries marked handed off'); the client receives it, becomes the simulator when the host's election drops the host, and adopts every copy WITH STATE via final; the adoption's own check (lastMatched = with-state count) proves each adopted body resumed exactly the snapshot's items done k/n and completed flag. LEG 2 (owner walks back in; PREMISE >= 1 UNBOOKED live customer - order not completed, not leaving - on the client before the owner walks in): the host follows the client for at most one election pass, then the booking-player rule makes him the simulator; he WAITS for the client's final (reason authority), the client swaps its natives to copies in place (N > 0 - the swap was always 0 before, DisableCustomersSpawn released them first), and the host adopts via final. Money: any client sale for a customer the host handed over reaches the host's books ('[Business] forwarded order ... accepted (handed off)', report-only - it occurs only if such a customer pays during leg 1); tilldupes 0 and shopday idUnbilled 0 on the owner. ORACLE NOTE: NullReferenceException carries the `(?<!swallowed )` lookbehind because fx-hq1 prints the mod's own '[Gley] swallowed NullReferenceException' diagnostic.

H-HANDOFF-1 WALK-IN RACE LEVER (2026-09-27): the next building change on the host runs the simulator election BEFORE the host tracks the building - the order that lost the client's crowd in runs T-HANDOFF1-20260927-073838 / -045549 (the owner decided simulator before it ever followed, held no copies, and dropped the client's Final). Since the fix the natural order is always follow-first (t-handoff2 / t-handoffseat cover it); this leg forces the bad order and asserts the late adopt at Final receipt takes the whole crowd over.
